description: The Annuaire de l'éducation is the Ministry of National Education's open directory of public and private education establishments open in France. It covers nursery and primary schools, secondary schools, medico-social establishments, information and guidance centres and administrative establishments, 68,572 rows when read, built from ONISEP and RAMSESE data. Each row gives the establishment identifier (UAI), name, type, public or private status, address, commune, department, academy and region codes, contact details, the tracks and sections offered (general, technological and vocational, special needs units, boarding and catering), priority education membership, opening date, latitude and longitude with a location precision flag and the original projected coordinates. Coverage: metropolitan France and overseas. Access: Opendatasoft portal with API and exports, refreshed daily. Licence: Licence Ouverte v2.0; free. Caveats: pupil numbers and building characteristics are not included, and location precision varies by row. Simulation uses are school locations for shelter planning, hazard exposure and education continuity studies. Related records: the German JedeSchule school register and the US NCES school locations.
